note: Model-to-ECU mapping for Moto Guzzi. Guzzi changed ECUs as running changes rather than on model-year boundaries, so overlapping entries are expected and the ECU label on the bike always wins over this table. Every entry carries a confidence level; anything marked 'inferred' has not been confirmed against a real motorcycle.
sources: Guzzitek ECU master list and La Guzzitheque injection bible (guzzitek.org)
GuzziDiag / IAWDiag ECU list and tutorials (von-der-salierburg.de, wildguzzi.com)
